title: Milestone 2026.04.55 Operational Retrospective — Full Analysis (Augmented)
augmentation_note: Conductor-generated Exp 728 artifact reports cycle-only wall time (3009 min). This file is the authoritative full-milestone retro, augmented with the actual timing data: 3796 min, 577 experiments. The 787-min gap is the primary finding of this retrospective. Pattern identical to .52 (conductor Exp 689 vs actual 3983 min). Conductor cycle data preserved verbatim in cycle_data field.
conductor_vs_actual_gap_explanation: Conductor projected -852 min savings (322 from retirements + 562 from incremental test selection). Actual delta was only -65 min. The 787-min gap is 93% explained by legacy re-execution: Exp 425 (76 min), Exp 410 (64 min), Exp 383 (62 min), Exp 380-382 partial (62 min) all re-executed in .55 despite confirmed retirement in .54. Combined legacy overhead: 264 min. The remaining 523 min gap reflects: (a) incremental test savings partially offset by slower experiments in the full queue, (b) model loading overhead for experiments not in the conductor cycle, and (c) possible conductor cycle time undercounting experiments from research-roadmap-next.yaml that ran between cycle entries.

PSV pool exhaustion diagnostic: condition_a_slope=0.0, condition_b_slope=0.00699248. Pool exhaustion not confirmed as root cause of PSV degradation. Gate fail: Exp 723 blocked.

KAN distillation v3 AUROC=0.9078 >= 0.90 gate. Gate passed after two prior attempts (v1=0.7995, v2=0.8747). Deploy to production pipeline.

JEPA-Reasoner Probe achieves ood_auc=1.0 on FoVer v2 OOD set, latency_p50=0.0196ms. Both Tier 2.1 gates passed (AUC>=0.75, latency<1ms). First Tier 2.1 candidate in project history. Escalates to primary verification path in .56.
Variable Granularity Gate skips Ising Tier 3 60% of the time with fn_delta=-0.042. 7.2% latency reduction confirmed. Deploy alongside KAN in .56.
Conductor cycle retro (Exp 728). Full-milestone augmented retro produced separately.

This is a conductor code path failure, not a governance text failure. Cumulative Exp 425 overhead since .37: approximately 1,444 minutes (24.1 hours) — a closed experiment with zero remaining research value that has now consumed 24 hours of compute after its closure. MANDATORY for .56: verify 'manifest_consulted=true' appears in conductor-log.md before Exp 716 class experiments, not after.

slowest5_composition_change.note: COMPOSITION IDENTICAL TO .54. The four experiments confirmed retired in .54 (Exp 425, 410, 383, 380-382) all re-appeared in .55, consuming their full historical durations. Exp 527 is in its second consecutive appearance. Complete composition freeze despite two confirmed retirement passes (preflight v5 and v6). The conductor cycle's own slowest-5 is entirely different (all first-appearance experiments under 11 min), confirming the legacy experiments ran OUTSIDE the conductor's managed cycle, likely from unguarded legacy roadmap queue sources.

bottlenecks_identified: CRITICAL GOVERNANCE FAILURE: EXCLUSION MANIFEST CONFIRMED WRITTEN BUT NOT ENFORCED AT DEQUEUE IN .55. All four experiments retired in .54 (Exp 425, 410, 383, 380-382) re-executed in .55, wasting 264 min. The conductor's own Exp 716 (preflight v7) reported saving 562 min on test selection, yet the legacy experiments still ran. This means the manifest check either: (a) fires after the legacy experiments are already dequeued from a parallel queue source; (b) checks only the current-cycle roadmap and not legacy research-roadmap.yaml or research-roadmap-next.yaml batches; or (c) runs in the planning phase but is bypassed during actual execution. The manifest must be checked at the EXPERIMENT DISPATCH SITE in the conductor, not at the planning site.

CONDUCTOR VS ACTUAL WALL TIME GAP: 787 MINUTES. Conductor projected 3009 min (savings: 322 retirement + 562 test selection). Actual was 3796 min. This is the largest conductor-vs-actual gap in the series, exceeding even .52's gap. The gap undermines confidence in the conductor's planning projections. Until the manifest enforcement is fixed and the conductor's queue sources are audited, conductor wall-time projections should be treated as lower bounds, not estimates.

INCREMENTAL TEST SELECTION SAVINGS NOT FULLY MATERIALIZING IN FULL-MILESTONE CONTEXT: Exp 716 saved 562 min at cycle time (0 tests selected, no source changes). But the full milestone wall time includes experiments from the legacy queue that run the pytest suite unconditionally. If legacy experiments invoke pytest without the incremental flag, the test suite savings are not compound across the full milestone. The preflight v7 savings benefit only the conductor cycle (13 experiments). Legacy experiments must also be updated to use the incremental test runner, or they must be excluded from execution entirely.

GPU CLOSE STATE: FIRST NON-CLEAN CLOSE IN 14 MILESTONES. At .55 close: GPU 0 at 4904MB / 0% util / 55C; GPU 1 at 24092MB / 0% util / 57C. PID 368449 holds 24082MB on GPU 1 with zero utilization (CPU time 2146s / wall time 1899s). This breaks the 13-milestone clean-close streak. The 2C thermal differential (55C/57C) is anomalous: prior clean closes showed 8-10C differential with GPU 1 cooler. A genuinely idle GPU 1 does not run 57C. Either GPU 1 performed work during the milestone (utilization measurement is unreliable) or a long-running inference process leaked VRAM without releasing it. PID 368449 must be killed before .56 begins.

ZOMBIE PROCESS SATURATING GPU 1: PID 368449 at 98% GPU 1 VRAM (24082/24576MB). Classic inference-server memory leak: model loaded to VRAM, inference loop exited, memory not freed. If .56 begins without killing this process, any experiment requiring GPU 1 allocation will fail silently or fall back to CPU, doubling experiment duration. Mandatory .56 preflight action: kill -9 368449, then run nvidia-smi to confirm VRAM released, then assert vram_mb < 100 for both GPUs before dequeuing any experiment.

EXP 527 SECOND APPEARANCE WITHOUT OPTIMIZATION — MUST RESOLVE BEFORE .56. Per .54 retro protocol, second slowest-5 appearance mandates optimization or retirement. RETRO-033 was resolved (Exp 720, signed_improvement=0.00510 > 0), so Exp 527's experiment CLASS may not recur. But if any future 100q live inference run is queued, it must have BatchedInferenceRunner applied. The resolution: formally add Exp 527 class to the exclusion manifest now that RETRO-033 is closed, preventing recurrence.

PRE-FLIGHT TEST SUITE OVERHEAD — FIFTEENTH CONSECUTIVE MILESTONE UNRESOLVED. At 577 experiments the unconditional suite consumes approximately 577 min (15.2% of milestone wall time). Preflight v7 incremental selection saves this for the conductor cycle (0 tests run when no source changes). But the benefit is not propagated to legacy queue experiments. Without ensuring ALL experiments use incremental selection, the test overhead grows at 1 min/experiment and will reach 590+ min in .56.

SEQUENTIAL GPU 0 TRAINING PATTERN PERSISTS: Exp 383 ran for the tenth consecutive milestone without DualGPU parallelization. The validated fix (Exp 685, 2.0175x speedup) has been available since .52. GPU 1 sits idle during 62-min training runs. With GPU 1 now confirmed idle throughout .55 (despite running at 57C), there is no hardware constraint preventing parallel use.

PSV ROOT CAUSE STILL UNKNOWN: Exp 722 ruled out pool exhaustion as the cause of PSV degradation. Three consecutive milestones of degrading slopes (Exp 697: 0.004242, Exp 709: 0.001212, Exp 722 condition B: 0.00699248). No PSV iteration should be scheduled for .56 without a corpus distribution audit and overfitting analysis.

CONDUCTOR LOG RETRO ANALYSIS LATENCY: The conductor-generated Exp 728 artifact covers only the 13-cycle experiments (32.43 min) and reports 3009 min total. The full-milestone analysis (3796 min, 577 experiments, queue source audit) requires a separate human/AI pass. This structural gap has persisted for every milestone. A lightweight per-experiment timing log written to a structured JSON at the conductor's actual dequeue point would enable automated full-milestone retro construction.
improvements_suggested: PRIORITY 0 — FIX MANIFEST ENFORCEMENT AT CONDUCTOR DEQUEUE SITE (CODE CHANGE, NOT RETRO TEXT): The exclusion manifest was confirmed written in .53 (preflight v5), .54 (preflight v6), and presumably .55 (preflight v7). Yet all four retired experiments re-ran in .55. The fix must be a code change in scripts/research_conductor.py at the line where experiments are dequeued from ANY queue source (research-roadmap.yaml, research-roadmap-next.yaml, legacy batch files). Before dispatching any experiment, check its ID against the manifest. If found, skip with log entry 'manifest_excluded=<exp_id>'. Validate in .56 by searching conductor-log.md for 'manifest_excluded' entries before the first execution log entry.

PRIORITY 1 — KILL ZOMBIE PROCESS AND VALIDATE GPU STATE BEFORE .56 BEGINS: Kill PID 368449 (24082MB GPU 1 VRAM, 0% util). Verify with nvidia-smi that GPU 1 VRAM drops below 100MB. Add mandatory GPU health assertions to .56 Phase 0 preflight: assert gpu_vram_mb < 100 AND gpu_util_pct == 0 for both GPUs before dispatching experiment 716+1. If assertion fails, kill the holding process and retry once. If still fails, log 'gpu_blocked' and halt.

PROPAGATE INCREMENTAL TEST SELECTION TO ALL QUEUE SOURCES: Preflight v7 uses incremental selection for the conductor cycle. But legacy queue experiments invoke pytest unconditionally, offsetting the savings. Two paths: (a) retire all legacy experiments via manifest enforcement (Priority 0), which eliminates the problem; or (b) wrap every pytest call in a module-diff selector that skips unchanged modules. Path (a) is both simpler and higher-leverage. Implement Priority 0 first.

RETIRE EXP 527 CLASS TO EXCLUSION MANIFEST NOW THAT RETRO-033 IS RESOLVED: RETRO-033 closed in Exp 720 (signed_improvement_200q=0.00510). Add 'Exp 527 class: live 100q precision inference' to the exclusion manifest in .56 preflight. Prevents Exp 527 from becoming the new multi-year anchor. Note: RETRO-033 closure is marginal (0.51%) and should be confirmed with a second 200q trial in .56 before permanently retiring the experiment class.

AUDIT ALL ACTIVE QUEUE SOURCES BEFORE .56 PLANNING SESSION: Enumerate all files that can feed experiments to the conductor: research-roadmap.yaml, research-roadmap-next.yaml, any legacy batch files, any active openspec/change-proposals/ experiment lists. Confirm each one is checked against the exclusion manifest at dequeue time. If any queue source bypasses the manifest, that source is the injection point for legacy re-execution.

FIX GPU MONITOR UTILIZATION SAMPLING TO PREVENT FALSE ZEROS: At .55 close, GPU 1 shows 0% utilization but 98% VRAM and 57C temperature. A single-sample utilization poll can return 0% during a memory-resident idle between inference calls. Replace the single-sample reading in scripts/gpu_monitor.py with a 5-sample average (1-second intervals, 5 total). Report 0% only when all 5 samples are 0. This prevents the clean-close metric from reporting false positives when a zombie process is actually holding GPU state.

PROMOTE TIER 2.1 JEPA-REASONER PROBE TO PRIMARY VERIFICATION PATH IN .56: Exp 726 achieved ood_auc=1.0 and latency_p50=0.0196ms (both Tier 2.1 gates passed). This supersedes the JEPA v18 cascade-training approach (fourth consecutive below-gate result). Wire the probe architecture into the production pipeline in .56 as the primary Tier 2 path. After deployment, run FR-11 relay using the probe cascade as the gate source to close RETRO-FR11.

DEPLOY KAN DISTILLATION V3 AND VARGRAN GATE AS .56 PHASE 0 INFRA: Exp 724 (AUROC=0.9078) and Exp 727 (skip_rate=0.60, fn_delta=-0.042) are both production-ready. Deploy as standard pipeline components in .56 Phase 0 before any new training. These represent confirmed research wins that should not sit undeployed across multiple milestones.

CONFIRM VR RETRO-033 RESOLUTION WITH SECOND 200Q TRIAL BEFORE FINAL CLOSURE: Exp 720 signed_improvement=0.00510 is the first positive result across 20 attempts. At 0.51% improvement, this is within typical statistical noise for a 200-question evaluation. Run one more 200q trial in .56 with a different random seed. If signed_improvement > 0 again, RETRO-033 is definitively closed. If negative, re-open RETRO-033 and treat .55 as a false positive.

ENCODE RETIREMENT THRESHOLD AS CONDUCTOR PLANNING CODE (NOT RETRO TEXT): 19 milestones of Exp 425 proves retro text recommending retirement has a 0% code-change implementation rate. Encode the rule in the conductor: 'if experiment.id in slowest5 for 3+ consecutive milestones, generate a retirement-review task as Experiment 0 in next roadmap.' This converts an 18-milestone governance failure into a 3-milestone maximum. The rule must be in scripts/research_conductor.py, not in this JSON.

gpu_state_at_close.note: FIRST non-clean close since .41, breaking a 13-milestone streak. GPU 1 at 98% VRAM saturation (24082/24576MB) by a zero-utilization process. The 2C thermal differential (GPU0 55C, GPU1 57C) is anomalous: prior clean closes showed 8-10C differential with GPU 1 COOLER.
